name: Lunokhod 3
def: Third generation Lunokhod completed in 1977 for a mission that was never funded, now preserved as a museum exhibit near Moscow.
body: Lunokhod 3 was finished as flight hardware with improved cameras and stereoscopic imaging, intended for a Luna 25 landing. No launcher or funding was allocated once the Soviet lunar programme wound down, so the rover never left Earth. It is displayed at the NPO Lavochkin museum in Khimki.
facts: Flight ready rover that never launched
Preserved intact at the NPO Lavochkin museum
specs: Lid mounted solar panel with radioisotope heater
Improved television and stereoscopic camera system
